title: pm: decision-digest extraction has hit its scripted-escalation trigger (42 open inbox cards) — freeze the facet-block rollup into a scripts/pm/ script
body:
Filed by the triage seat (session `session_01JEhkB6ShK2HHDzozy7Qwgz`, 2026-08-19) under the recorded exit in the pm-dispatch skill's escalation section: "收件箱持续 >20 张 open,或刷新节奏到达每日 ⇒ 把提取冻结进 `scripts/pm/` rollup 脚本" — the trigger is met, so this card records it rather than redesigning anything in-session.

## Measured trigger (2026-08-19 ~06:1xZ)

- objectstack `needs-user-decision` open: **8**
- objectui: **29**
- objectos: **5**
- Total: **42** — persistently above the 20-card line (it was ~33 two rounds ago and has only grown).

The digest (#9822) is currently refreshed by hand each triage round: label queries per repo + literal grep for the `os-decision-facets` marker + verbatim transcription into the pinned body. At 42 cards the manual transcription no longer fits a round's budget — 23 objectui legacy cards have been queued for transcription across four consecutive rounds without being absorbed.

## Scope

A `scripts/pm/` rollup script that: queries `needs-user-decision` across the in-scope repos; extracts each card's facet block by the literal `os-decision-facets` marker text (grep for the escaped spelling too — sanitizer variants exist, see the platform-readings notes); emits the digest body (blocks verbatim, zero paraphrase; cards without a block listed in an "awaiting backfill" section); the triage seat then pastes/PUTs the generated body into #9822. One-board rule holds: the script generates a view, authority stays on the cards.

Constraints from standing rulings: blocks are transcribed verbatim (2026-08-18 「同意」— standardized block + batch channel); the digest is a generated view, never a second tracker; the batch-adjudication instructions in the header must spell pairs as `#9807 B` (no angle-bracket placeholders — sanitizer eats them).

`domain:skills` (SUBJECT is the PM decision-digest protocol; the script is its mechanical half). Unassigned — dispatch via the skills lane.
